page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg8i.8xlarge is an instance from the High Clock Speed family running under KVM virtualization. The configuration provides 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor based on the x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. Memory capacity is set to 128.0 GB, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM allocated per virtual core.

The virtual machine does not bundle local disk storage, meaning persistent data storage is completely offloaded to external network block devices. Discrete hardware accelerators are absent, with zero GPUs present. Network capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, while zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

The combination of dedicated 3.3 GHz core execution, balanced memory distribution, and high-throughput networking targets compute workloads requiring stable single-thread frequencies and multi-core scalability. Suitable deployment targets include relational database instances, multi-threaded application servers, compilation clusters, continuous integration pipelines, and high-concurrency web serving infrastructure.
